deep_review.conclusion: MCP server and SDK runtime reviewed. run_create/run_iterate take a process `entrypoint` ("path/to/file.js#export") that the SDK loads with a dynamic import() (packages/sdk/src/runtime/orchestrateIteration.ts), so any agent connected to the babysitter MCP server can make it execute local JavaScript. Use only with a trusted process library and a trusted MCP client.
